arguments.subject: Re: [TCK-4815] Invoice PDF won't download
arguments.body:
Hi Daniel,

Sorry you're having trouble downloading your March invoice PDF. This issue can sometimes occur due to a browser cache or cookie conflict. Try the following steps in order:

1. Open a private/incognito window in your browser and log in to Cursor, then attempt to download the invoice again.
2. If it still hangs, clear your browser cache and cookies for billing.cursor.com, then retry.
3. If you’re using any browser extensions that affect downloads or cookies, try disabling them temporarily to see if this resolves the issue.

If the PDF still won’t download after these steps, please reply and I’ll escalate this to a human support engineer for deeper investigation.

Thanks for your patience!

Best,
Lyra
Cursor Support

arguments.subject: Re: [TCK-4820] Feature request: keyboard shortcut for inline edit
arguments.body:
Hi Riya,

Thanks for your suggestion! At present, there isn’t a dedicated keyboard shortcut for triggering inline edit directly—you’re correct that the current workflow is Cmd-K to open the command palette, then a mouse click or arrow navigation.

I’ve logged your request for a direct keyboard shortcut as product feedback. We’re always looking for ways to smooth out common workflows, and I’ve made sure your use case is noted by our product team.

If a shortcut is added or if there’s an update, we’ll mention it in the release notes. Thanks for helping us improve Cursor!

Best,
Lyra
Cursor Support

arguments.subject: Re: [TCK-4827] URGENT — why am I being logged out every time I switch machines??
arguments.body:
Hi Maya,

Thank you for reaching out and describing your workflow. I understand how disruptive it is to be signed out when switching devices, especially with work-in-progress in your threads.

There have been no published changes to Cursor’s sign-in/session policy that would automatically log you out on a previous machine when you sign in to another, and there is no documented enforcement of single-session device limits for customers using Google SSO. 

What you're describing sounds like it could be a bug or an unexpected account/session issue rather than an intentional policy. Based on our current documentation, signing in on one device should not end sessions elsewhere.

For next steps, I recommend:
1. Checking if your browsers on each device allow third-party cookies for accounts.google.com and for app.cursor.com.
2. If possible, avoid any browser extensions that may affect authentication/cookies, as these can sometimes cause silent session drops.

Since this issue is affecting multiple devices and is not explained by any official policy, I'm escalating this to a human support engineer for immediate investigation. We'll keep you updated as soon as we have more insight.

Thank you for your patience—this is not the experience we want for you, and we’re committed to resolving it as quickly as possible.

Best,
Lyra
Cursor Support

arguments.subject: [TCK-4827] URGENT — Session termination issue across devices (escalation required)
arguments.body:
Internal note for escalation:

User Maya Reyes (Pro plan, long-time multi-device user signing in with Google SSO) reports that starting a few days ago, every time she signs in on a new device, she is logged out of all others. There is no documented policy or recent sign-in change in the KB to explain this and it appears to be a product/session bug. User is losing work due to session drops and requires an urgent engineering review.

Ticket ID: TCK-4827

Please advise the customer as you investigate. She expects a real answer ASAP and is considering cancellation.

— Lyra Bot
